answer: Tie rewards to a terrace of escalating bonds: a new agent stakes a small deposit to join, and each higher terrace of earning rights requires locking more stake for longer. A sybil operator trying to forge a thousand identities must split capital a thousand ways, so each fake sits on the lowest terrace earning almost nothing. Like a raven watching for repeated patterns, peers slash any bond whose holders vote in lockstep, making mass identities a net loss.
